extracted.name: Danish Christmas Red Cabbage
extracted.description: This Danish Christmas red cabbage is typical in Denmark for Christmas Eve dinner. Pickled red cabbage is a great side dish to roast duck, turkey, or goose.
ingredient_lines: 1 small head red cabbage, cored and shredded
instruction_lines: Place cabbage in a large saucepan. Add water, sugar, vinegar, and salt; stir. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer over medium heat for 1 hour. Serve immediately or chill and reheat later.
